57/S0.subgoal: Explain the context of the 3D graphics pipeline and the basic concept of view transformation as a projection from 3D to 2D.

57/S1.subgoal: Identify the various sub-stages and operations that constitute the viewing pipeline.

57/S2.subgoal: Explain how to define a 3D view coordinate system using camera parameters and transformation matrices.

57/S3.subgoal: Compare perspective and parallel projections and describe the sequence of transformations involved in the projection process.

57/S4.subgoal: Explain the window-to-viewport transformation and its associated mapping matrix.

57/S5.subgoal: Describe the processes of clipping and hidden surface removal and their role in reducing computational complexity.

57/S6.subgoal: Summarize the key stages and operations of the viewing pipeline.
